title: Prospective news negativity and daily variance
claim: Negative GDELT and reviewed RSS intensity improves next-day variance forecasts beyond the registered HAR-style control.
mechanism: Adverse narratives increase uncertainty, disagreement, and risk-sensitive repositioning.
primaryBaseline: Identical 1/7/30-day log-HAR model without news negativity
nextAction: Complete prospective news source readiness and start only with the common social-program clock.
